description: Part of t1896-hypgeom-cdf-wide (pending since #4123): sheet Rare rows 9, 12 (and its header row 1), plus the Precision sheet. The whole t1896-hypgeom-cdf-wide workbook failed twice on excel-graph (Graph's calculate or createSession, retries exhausted; #4124), so docs/research/probe-handoff-2026-11-11-wave2.md splits it into one workbook per sheet, with each HYPGEOM.DIST cdf row over 2^17 summed terms in groups of at most 6 rows. Sheet names, cell addresses and formulas are t1896-hypgeom-cdf-wide's, so its frozen predictions apply cell for cell. t1896-hypgeom-cdf-wide: T-1896: HYPGEOM.DIST cdf at wide distributions (standard deviation 3,500 to 11,585; populations 4E8 to 2^31 - 2), x at the mean and within three standard deviations, and one call 43 standard deviations above the mode. E the cdf, F the pmf, G (E)=1. The engine returns Excel's identified form there (the pmf at x times one plus a sum of ratios, T-2481); Excel's values are unprobed. A calculate request on a single wide cdf has failed before (statistics.md, "HYPGEOM.DIST of an empty population is 1 ..."): if the fill fails, say which rows. Sheet Rare: twelve points where successes or failures are rare (2E5 to 5E6) in a population of 1E9 to 2^31 - 2, x within three standard deviations below the mean: there the engine's cdf is up to 4E-10 (relative) from the 50-digit value, the relative error of its pmf at x, and whether that is Excel's own is what these rows ask (E the cdf, F the pmf, G (E)=0). Frozen model values: docs/research/t1896-cdf-wide-predictions.json. Predictions are hypotheses, NOT expected values. Precision!B2:B4 must retain 0.9999999999999998, 1, 1.0000000000000002; C2:C4 must be -1,0,1.
